name: Village
description: Small settlements where heroes can recruit basic units and rest.

interactions.name: Recruit Unit
interactions.description: Recruit a Regular Unit from the Unit Offer. Cost is modified by Reputation.

interactions.name: Heal
interactions.description: Pay 3 Influence to heal 1 Wound. Can be repeated.

interactions.name: Plunder
interactions.effect: Draw 2 cards from your Deed deck
interactions.description: Raid the village for resources. Draw 2 cards but lose 1 Reputation.

rules: Cannot recruit if Reputation is X (-5)
Reputation affects recruiting cost: +1 cost per negative reputation, -1 cost per positive
Plundering draws 2 cards from your own Deed deck
After plundering, you can no longer interact peacefully this turn

name: Monastery
description: Sacred places where heroes can learn Advanced Actions and heal more cheaply.

interactions.name: Recruit Unit
interactions.description: Recruit a Regular Unit from the Unit Offer.

interactions.name: Heal
interactions.description: Pay 2 Influence to heal 1 Wound. Monasteries offer cheaper healing than villages.

interactions.name: Training
interactions.description: Pay 6 Influence to gain an Advanced Action card from the Advanced Action offer.
interactions.note: Choose any Advanced Action from the offer. Place it in your discard pile.

interactions.name: Burn Monastery
interactions.description: Attack the monastery. Fight 1 Violet enemy. If victorious, gain 1 Artifact and lose 3 Reputation.

rules: Healing is cheaper than at Villages (2 Influence vs 3)
Training costs 6 Influence regardless of card
Burning a monastery destroys it permanently (cannot be used again)
After burning, the hex becomes empty terrain

name: Mage Tower
description: Mystical towers where heroes can learn Spells. Must be conquered or interacted with peacefully.

assault.description: Attack the tower. Defeat 1 Violet enemy to conquer. Siege attacks required in Ranged phase.

interactions.name: Recruit Unit
interactions.description: Recruit a Unit from the Unit Offer.

interactions.name: Learn Spell
interactions.description: Pay 7 Influence + 1 Mana of the spell's color to learn a Spell from the Spell Offer.
interactions.note: Mana color must match the spell's color. Gold mana can substitute.

interactions_when_conquered.name: Recruit Unit
interactions_when_conquered.description: Recruit Units with reputation modifier when you control the tower.

interactions_when_conquered.name: Learn Spell
interactions_when_conquered.description: Learn a Spell from the Spell Offer.

interactions_when_conquered.name: Shelter
interactions_when_conquered.description: Safe place to end turn without Forced Withdrawal.

rules: Fortified site - Siege attacks required in Ranged phase
Learning a spell requires mana matching the spell's color
When conquered, provides shelter (safe end-of-turn location)
Conquered towers can still be used for recruiting and learning spells

name: Keep
description: Fortified military strongholds. Must be conquered to use for recruiting.

assault.description: Attack the keep. Defeat 1 Grey enemy to conquer. Siege attacks required.

interactions_when_conquered.name: Recruit Unit
interactions_when_conquered.description: Recruit Regular Units from the Unit Offer when you control this Keep.

interactions_when_conquered.name: Shelter
interactions_when_conquered.description: Safe place to end turn without Forced Withdrawal.

rules: Fortified site - Siege attacks required in Ranged phase
Cannot interact until conquered
Provides shelter when controlled
Other players entering your occupied Keep must fight you (PvP)

name: City
description: Major urban centers. Cities are the main objectives in many scenarios and have powerful rewards.

assault.description: Attack the city. Number of White enemies depends on city level (2-6).

interactions_when_conquered.name: Recruit Any Unit
interactions_when_conquered.description: Recruit any type of Unit (Regular or Elite) from the Unit Offer.

interactions_when_conquered.name: Buy Fame
interactions_when_conquered.description: The city Leader can spend 2 Influence to gain 1 Fame. Can be repeated.

interactions_when_conquered.name: Learn Spell
interactions_when_conquered.description: Learn a Spell from the Spell Offer. Requires mana matching the spell color.

interactions_when_conquered.name: Training
interactions_when_conquered.description: Pay 6 Influence to gain an Advanced Action card.

interactions_when_conquered.name: Shelter
interactions_when_conquered.description: Safe place to end turn without Forced Withdrawal.

rules: Fortified site - no Ranged attacks against city defenders
City level determines number of defenders (Level 1 = 2 enemies, Level 5 = 6 enemies)
First player to conquer becomes Leader and gains extra Fame benefits
Other players may co-occupy but only Leader can buy Fame
Cities provide all services when conquered: recruiting, healing, spells, advanced actions

name: Magical Glade
description: Mystical clearings imbued with healing magic and mana.

interactions.name: Free Heal
interactions.description: Heal 1 Wound for free once per visit.

interactions.name: Empower (Day)
interactions.description: During Day: Gain 1 Gold Crystal to your Inventory.

interactions.name: Empower (Night)
interactions.description: During Night: Gain 1 Black Mana token (temporary, lasts until end of turn).

interactions.name: Cleanse Corruption
interactions.description: Spend 5 Heal points to cleanse a corrupted glade. Gain 2 Fame, +1 Reputation, and 1 random Crystal.

rules: Safe location - no combat
Empower effect depends on Day/Night
Glades can become corrupted (shown with dark overlay)
Corrupted glades don't provide normal benefits until cleansed

name: Red Crystal Mine
description: A mine that produces Red crystals.

interactions.name: Harvest Crystals
interactions.description: Gain 1 Red Crystal to your Inventory.

rules: Can harvest once per visit
Crystal goes to your Inventory (persists between turns)

name: Blue Crystal Mine
description: A mine that produces Blue crystals.

interactions.name: Harvest Crystals
interactions.description: Gain 1 Blue Crystal to your Inventory.

rules: Can harvest once per visit
Crystal goes to your Inventory (persists between turns)

name: White Crystal Mine
description: A mine that produces White crystals.

interactions.name: Harvest Crystals
interactions.description: Gain 1 White Crystal to your Inventory.

rules: Can harvest once per visit
Crystal goes to your Inventory (persists between turns)

name: Green Crystal Mine
description: A mine that produces Green crystals.

interactions.name: Harvest Crystals
interactions.description: Gain 1 Green Crystal to your Inventory.

rules: Can harvest once per visit
Crystal goes to your Inventory (persists between turns)

name: Dungeon
description: Underground lairs filled with monsters and treasure. Night combat rules apply.

rules: NightRules
combat.description: Fight using Night combat rules regardless of actual time. Black mana available, Gold mana unavailable.

reward.description: Draw 2 Artifacts, keep 1, put other at bottom of Artifact deck.

rules: Entering triggers mandatory combat
Night rules always apply: Black mana available, Gold mana unavailable
Must defeat all enemies to claim reward
After cleared, dungeon becomes empty (cannot be entered again)

name: Tomb
description: Ancient burial sites guarded by a powerful Draconum. Extremely dangerous but rewarding.

rules: NightRules
combat.description: Fight a Draconum using Night combat rules. Draconum are the most powerful enemies.

reward.description: Gain 1 Artifact (draw 2, keep 1) AND 1 Spell from the Spell Offer.

rules: Entering triggers mandatory combat
Night rules always apply
Red (Draconum) enemies are extremely powerful - prepare well
Rewards are very valuable: both Artifact AND Spell

name: Monster Den
description: Lairs of dangerous creatures. Standard combat rules apply.

combat.description: Fight 1 Brown enemy using normal Day/Night rules.

reward.description: Gain 2 Crystals of any colors you choose.

rules: Entering triggers mandatory combat
Standard Day/Night rules apply (unlike Dungeons/Tombs)
Choose any colors for the 2 crystal reward

name: Spawning Grounds
description: Breeding grounds for monsters. More dangerous than dens with better rewards.

combat.description: Fight 2 Brown enemies simultaneously. Both attack in Block phase.

reward.description: Draw 2 Artifacts, keep 1, put other at bottom of deck.

rules: Entering triggers mandatory combat
Must fight both enemies at once (simultaneous)
Both enemies attack during Block phase
Standard Day/Night rules apply

name: Ancient Ruins
description: Mysterious ruins with variable encounters. Draw a Ruins token to see what awaits.

rules: RuinsToken
combat.description: Draw a Ruins token. May be loot (immediate reward) or combat (fight enemies).

reward.description: Reward depends on drawn token. Loot tokens give immediate rewards, combat tokens require defeating enemies first.

rules: Draw Ruins token when entering
Loot tokens: Take reward immediately, no combat
Combat tokens: Fight specified enemies, then gain standard adventure site fame
Used Ruins tokens are returned to bottom of Ruins deck

name: Draconum Lair
description: Lairs of the mighty Draconum. These dragons can be challenged or may provoke attacks.

rules: Rampaging
combat.description: Challenge the Draconum to voluntary combat, or be attacked if moving between adjacent hexes.

rules: Rampaging enemy - placed face-up on the map
Moving between two hexes adjacent to the Draconum provokes an attack
Can be challenged voluntarily from an adjacent hex
Extremely powerful - Draconum are the strongest enemies
Defeating grants 2 Artifacts and bonus Fame

name: Marauding Orcs
description: Orc war parties roaming the land. They attack those who pass by.

rules: Rampaging
combat.description: Fight the Orc when moving between adjacent hexes, or challenge voluntarily.

reward.description: Gain 2 bonus Fame in addition to the enemy's base Fame value.

rules: Rampaging enemy - placed face-up on the map
Moving between two hexes adjacent to the Orcs provokes an attack
Can be challenged voluntarily from an adjacent hex
Grants bonus Fame when defeated

name: Portal
description: Starting location and safe haven. Portals provide shelter.

interactions.name: Shelter
interactions.description: Safe place to end turn without Forced Withdrawal.

rules: Starting location for heroes
Always provides shelter (safe end-of-turn)
Cannot be destroyed or conquered
